8. The Downtown Expressway
Proposed design: The alignment of the expressway through a. the project area is depicted in the above illustration. The expressway through the northern perimeter of the Randolph Project is a six lane, controlled access facility. At the west project boundary, the highway is depressed below the surrounding ground elevation, rising as it moves east until it reaches existing ground level at Addison Street. From Addison Street to Rowland Street the route drops 20 feet below existing terrain and remains at this level until it reaches Allen Avenue, where the grade begins to rise. The expressway will meet existing ground level at Lombardy Street, where a toll plaza of eight lanes is proposed.
